advice_items.quote: Psychology, understand human nature, and don't push people.
advice_items.summary_en: Understand psychology and human nature, and avoid being pushy when selling.
advice_items.summary_zh: 洞察人性心理，销售切忌强推

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Take Profits Out of the Business
advice_items.quote: Take the money, don't keep putting it back in, 'cause you keep spending your money.
advice_items.summary_en: Take profits off the table instead of endlessly putting money back into the business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 落袋为安，别把赚的钱全投回生意里

advice_items.quote: When opportunity meets preparation, you have luck.
advice_items.summary_en: Scaling to nine figures happens when thorough preparation meets opportunity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 机会遇上充分准备才能带来好运与突破

advice_items.quote: I just go for it.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain high risk tolerance as a business owner and go for opportunities boldly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业者要有魄力，看准机会果断出手

advice_items.quote: I had to just do it, make mistakes, but I learn.
advice_items.summary_en: Jump in, make mistakes, and treat them as lessons to get smarter.
advice_items.summary_zh: 勇敢行动并允许试错，在犯错中不断学习

advice_items.quote: I started over again out of the trunk of a car at 40.
advice_items.summary_en: Refuse to quit after near-bankruptcy and be willing to rebuild from rock bottom.
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝境不屈，40岁也能在汽车后备箱里东山再起

guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家，曾两次濒临破产，40岁时在汽车后备箱里重新起步；后来将Jewel香烟推向市场并与泰森等名人合作，做到年营收1.5亿美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 洞察人性心理、不要强推，保持高风险承受力并敢于在试错中学习，赚钱后注意落袋为安。

advice_items.quote: You got to always give the best service, best hospitality.
advice_items.summary_en: Deliver unmatched customer service and hospitality to scale across locations.
advice_items.summary_zh: 始终提供最顶级的服务与款待体验

advice_items.quote: You got to have the best team behind you.
advice_items.summary_en: Build and rely on the best possible team behind your business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 背后必须拥有最优秀的团队支持

advice_items.quote: You got to constantly stay honest, be honest with all your friends, be honest with all your investors.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay honest and loyal to your friends, partners, and investors at all times.
advice_items.summary_zh: 对朋友、合伙人和投资人始终保持诚实忠诚

advice_items.quote: In business you need friends, you need relationships, you need partners.
advice_items.summary_en: Build strong friendships, relationships, and partnerships to fund and launch ventures.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做生意必须建立人脉关系并找到好伙伴

advice_items.quote: There's never financial freedom, you always got to work harder and you always got to thrive to get more and more.
advice_items.summary_en: Never become complacent; keep working harder and striving for growth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 永不懈怠，必须不断努力追求更高目标

advice_items.quote: You got to stay true to your brand and believe in yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay authentic to your brand and maintain strong self-belief.
advice_items.summary_zh: 忠于自己的品牌并坚定相信自己

advice_items.quote: Of course... very important, all these things are very important.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep faith in God as a foundational pillar of life and business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 信仰在成功路上至关重要

guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家、曾历破产困顿，依靠人脉与合伙人筹集资金创办Poppy Steak餐厅，并在疫情期间于佛罗里达迎来业务爆发。
guests.zero_start_advice: 对朋友、合伙人和投资人保持绝对诚实忠诚，打造顶级团队与服务体验，忠于品牌、坚信自己并持续努力。

advice_items.quote: Believe in yourself always... you count me out, I'm going to do it.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain unwavering self-belief and use doubters as fuel to prove them wrong.
advice_items.summary_zh: 永远相信自己，把他人看轻化作动力

advice_items.quote: Every time I was told no, I continued to push through.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep pushing forward every time someone rejects or counts you out.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每次被拒绝时都要继续顶住并向前冲

advice_items.quote: They went into the high dollar district... their rent's $38,000 a month... they have no money in the bank to back them, they're setting themselves up for failure from the very get-go.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid oversized rent and equipment spending early on so you keep cash reserves in the bank.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业初期别盲目高额租店和花光储备现金

advice_items.quote: What budget are we working with, what is your rent, what is your payroll?
advice_items.summary_en: Know your exact budget, rent, and payroll numbers before committing capital.
advice_items.summary_zh: 动工前必须算清预算、房租和薪资账目

advice_items.quote: No business is a get-rich-quick, point blank period.
advice_items.summary_en: Do not enter business expecting easy, overnight wealth without putting in the hours.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没有任何生意能一夜暴富

advice_items.quote: If you want to put in the work you can make it, but you got to be able to sleep at the business.
advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to outwork everyone and live at your business until it succeeds.
advice_items.summary_zh: 要想做成生意就得做好睡在店里的准备

guests.first_money_or_break: 希腊移民家庭出身，白手起家；15年前一边备战健美比赛一边靠花生酱果酱三明治度日，每周在Craigslist发400条广告卖健身器材，2015年Facebook积累10万粉丝后逐步将健身房器材业务做向全球。
guests.zero_start_advice: 永远相信自己并无视否定，算清预算、房租与薪资成本，保留银行现金流，做好亲力亲为甚至睡在店里的准备，切勿幻想一夜暴富。

advice_items.quote: You have to have a system if you want to win... the system's so good that a 15-year-old can run the business.
advice_items.summary_en: Build a repeatable, watertight business system so simple anyone can execute it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造标准化可复制的商业系统才能稳赢

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: Don't spend your earned income, invest it in assets.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid spending earned income on luxuries until passive asset cash flow covers your goals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把主动收入花掉，要将其投入资产

advice_items.quote: Whatever you can afford every single month, you put it into an S&P ETF and let it grow.
advice_items.summary_en: Dollar-cost average into an S&P 500 ETF every month to compound your initial cash.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每月定投标普500 ETF，让资金持续复利

advice_items.quote: Work your ass off in your vehicle and your business.
advice_items.summary_en: Work relentlessly in your primary income vehicle to fuel your asset investments.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在赚钱的主业中拼尽全力深耕打拼

advice_items.quote: Once you get to a certain point you have money compounding, start investing in multifamily.
advice_items.summary_en: Transition accumulated capital into multifamily real estate for cash flow and appreciation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 资金积累到一定阶段后投资多户住宅房产

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: The bank will lend you because it's not a personal residence, they want to see cash flow... those seven people paid the debt load.
advice_items.summary_en: Use bank debt on cash-flowing multifamily properties where tenants pay off the loan.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用银行贷款买下租金能覆盖月供的房产

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: Whether I work or not, sitting here with this guy, I'm making money right now standing here. That's what you got to be doing.
advice_items.summary_en: Build passive residual income streams so you earn money even when not working.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造不靠出卖时间也能自动生钱的被动资产

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年穷困时为解决房租问题买下一栋8户公寓，靠另外7户租客偿还贷款实现免费居住并翻倍卖出；事业上深耕直销、客户管理与线索分发，打造出高自动化的数字产品系统，累计创造超20亿美元销售额。
guests.role_or_title: Entrepreneur & Systems Creator (Direct Sales & Digital Products)
guests.zero_start_advice: 先找到能大量赚取主动收入的事业并打造标准化系统，不要花掉主动收入，而是每月定投标普500 ETF复利增长，之后投资多户住宅房产，等被动收入足够再享受消费。

advice_items.quote: Found a passion for helping other people, turned it into a business, blew it out of the water.
advice_items.summary_en: Turn a genuine personal passion for helping others into a thriving business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把帮助他人的热情转化为事业并做到极致

advice_items.quote: Get into Section 8 real estate right now... it produces higher than average cash-on-cash returns because the federal government overpays on the rent.
advice_items.summary_en: Invest in Section 8 properties for low entry prices and strong government-backed cash flow.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资低门槛高回报的Section 8房产

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: Reduce your lifestyle a little bit, save your money, take your savings and put that savings into an appreciating, cash-flowing asset.
advice_items.summary_en: Trim lifestyle spending, save aggressively, and buy appreciating cash-flowing assets.
advice_items.summary_zh: 降低生活消费并攒钱投入升值生息资产

advice_items.quote: If you do that consistently enough, there'll become a breaking point where you have enough money coming from your real estate assets to pay for your lifestyle.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep investing consistently until passive asset cash flow surpasses your living expenses.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持定投生息资产直至被动收入覆盖开销

advice_items.quote: Drugs and alcohol are for losers. If you do drugs and alcohol, the chances of you ever being financially free... are almost zero.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay completely away from drugs, alcohol, and destructive vices if you want success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 彻底远离毒品与酒精等不良嗜好

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Surround Yourself With Toxic / Negative People
advice_items.quote: Your circle matters more than you realize. I see too many young people... hanging out with losers doing loser stuff.
advice_items.summary_en: Distance yourself from unmotivated peers and stay ruthlessly loyal to your future.
advice_items.summary_zh: 果断疏远不思进取的损友圈层

advice_items.quote: Chase relationships with winners and successful people that are like-minded that want the same things.
advice_items.summary_en: Intentionally pursue relationships with like-minded winners heading in the same direction.
advice_items.summary_zh: 主动结交志同道合的成功者与赢家

guests.first_money_or_break: 21岁成功戒除毒瘾与酒瘾后发掘了助人热情，将其创办为新英格兰地区最大的戒瘾治疗服务机构，并于2021年以超过1亿美元的价格出售公司。
guests.role_or_title: Former Addiction Treatment Business Founder & Real Estate Investor
guests.zero_start_advice: 远离毒品酒精，果断筛选社交圈并结交成功者；同时压缩生活开销，把积蓄持续投入Section 8等升值且有现金流的房产，直到被动租金覆盖生活。
